summary: REQ-1 and most of REQ-2 appear implemented via a new /login page, header conditional "Log In" button, and explicit balance loading/error UI with retry/refresh. REQ-3 is not implemented and may be worsened: backend still traps with "Authorization system not ready" instead of automatically initializing authorization before onboarding/balance calls.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend authorization initialization so that authenticated users can call onboarding and wallet/balance methods without hitting the "Authorization system not ready" trap, and ensure initialization/admin recognition is not lost across canister upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend introduces/keeps an ensureInitialized() guard that explicitly traps when not initialized, rather than automatically initializing before user-facing methods. There is no evidence in the diff summary of automatic initialization occurring prior to onboarding() or other user flows.

hallucinated_features.description: Added URL/session parameter utility helpers (URL parsing, sessionStorage persistence, hash param clearing) unrelated to login button, wallet/balance display, or backend auth initialization.
Introduced a separate legacy admin wallet balance method (getAdminWalletBalanceLegacy).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; REQ-3 only asks that admin-only methods keep working across upgrades, not that a new legacy method be added.
